tools.name: list_slots

tools.name: g1_search_components
tools.title: Search GH1 Components
tools.description: Search the Grasshopper component library. The query is split into words and every word must appear somewhere in Name, NickName, Description, Category or SubCategory (case-insensitive), so 'XY plane' finds 'World XY'. Exact name matches rank first, then names carrying every word. Optional exact-match category/subcategory filters. Excludes obsolete/hidden unless includeDeprecated. Returns up to 'limit' matches.

query.description: Substring to match against component Name, NickName, and Description. Case-insensitive.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

includeDeprecated.description: Include obsolete/hidden components (e.g. legacy scripting). Default false.

tools.description: Ask the Rhino user to choose among options when you need a decision you cannot make yourself. Pass EVERY question you need answered in this one call: the Rhino AI panel shows them one page at a time (radio for single choice, checkboxes for multi) and returns them as a single reply. This tool does NOT wait for the answers: it poses the questions and returns immediately. Only on success, STOP and end your turn; on failure, fix the input and retry; the user's answers arrive as their next message, then continue.

tools.description: Return a structured snapshot of the active GH1 canvas: objects (with messages, inputs/outputs and optional volatile data summaries) and wires between them.

sample_size.description: How many items to include in each data sample.

slot.description: Slot ID returned by spawn_slot. Omit to use the Rhino you're already working in (the one you last used, or one you have open); a new Rhino is auto-spawned only if none is running.

tools.name: g1_connect_many
tools.title: Connect GH1 Wires (Batch)
tools.description: Wire multiple output→input connections in one call. Same selector semantics as 'g1_connect' (numeric index or Name/NickName; '' or '0' for pure params). A failed wire does not stop later ones; per-wire results are returned. solve runs once at the end.

wires.description: Array of {SrcId, Src, DstId, Dst} wire descriptors.

replace.description: If true (the default), sources already wired into a destination input before this call are removed first. Wires added within this same call accumulate. Pass false to add alongside everything.

solve.description: If true, trigger a new solution after wiring. Set false to batch further.

slot.description: Slot ID returned by spawn_slot. Omit to use the Rhino you're already working in (the one you last used, or one you have open); a new Rhino is auto-spawned only if none is running.

tools.name: get_context
tools.title: Get Context Snapshot
tools.description: One round-trip grounding snapshot of current state: the active-doc selection (ids/types/layers), the active viewport (name + camera summary), a doc summary (object/layer counts), and one Grasshopper summary per version (Version 'GH1' or 'GH2', each with component/wire counts when that canvas is open). Read-only; pulls everything you need to orient before acting, and never opens a canvas that is not already open.

slot.description: Slot ID returned by spawn_slot. Omit to use the Rhino you're already working in (the one you last used, or one you have open); a new Rhino is auto-spawned only if none is running.

tools.name: g1_apply_graph
tools.title: Apply GH1 Graph
tools.description: Place sliders + components and wire them in one call. References between objects use caller-supplied 'key' strings; the tool returns the key→Guid map. Failures in any step do not abort the rest; results report per-step status. Wire src/dst use the same selector semantics as 'g1_connect'.

sliders.description: Sliders to place: {Key, Min, Value, Max, Type, Name?, X, Y}. Type ∈ 'float'|'int'|'even'|'odd'.

components.description: Components to place: {Key, Selector, X, Y}. Selector is a Guid (preferred — avoids name ambiguity) or component Name.

wires.description: Wires to create: {SrcKey, Src, DstKey, Dst}. Keys must match a slider or component key above.

solve.description: If true, trigger a new solution at the end.

replace.description: If true (the default), sources already wired into a destination input before this call are removed first. Wires added within this same call accumulate. Pass false to add alongside everything.

includeDeprecated.description: Also match obsolete/hidden components by name (a Guid always works). Default false.

slot.description: Slot ID returned by spawn_slot. Omit to use the Rhino you're already working in (the one you last used, or one you have open); a new Rhino is auto-spawned only if none is running.

tools.name: set_layer_material
tools.title: Set Layer Material
tools.description: Set the render material on a layer. Accepts diffuse color, transparency, and gloss. Optionally also sets the layer display color.

color.description: Diffuse color hex like '#FF0000' or known color name

applyToLayerColor.description: Also apply color as the layer display (wireframe) color

slot.description: Slot ID returned by spawn_slot. Omit to use the Rhino you're already working in (the one you last used, or one you have open); a new Rhino is auto-spawned only if none is running.

tools.name: run_csharp
tools.title: Run C# Script
tools.description: Execute a C# script targeted at this slot's document. The script editor injects `__rhino_doc__` (type `RhinoDoc`) — use it as your document handle instead of `RhinoDoc.ActiveDoc` or anything else. System/Linq/Collections.Generic are auto-injected if missing.

slot.description: Slot ID returned by spawn_slot. Omit to use the Rhino you're already working in (the one you last used, or one you have open); a new Rhino is auto-spawned only if none is running.

tools.name: list_objects
tools.title: List Document Objects
tools.description: List objects in the active document. Filter by name, layer, or geometry type. Pure query — does not change selection or viewport.

geometryType.description: Filter by type: point, pointset, curve, surface, brep, mesh, annotation, light, block

limit.description: Maximum number of objects to return (default 1000)

slot.description: Slot ID returned by spawn_slot. Omit to use the Rhino you're already working in (the one you last used, or one you have open); a new Rhino is auto-spawned only if none is running.

tools.name: g1_place_slider
tools.title: Place GH1 Number Slider
tools.description: Place a Number Slider on the active GH1 canvas with the given range and current value. type: 'float' | 'int' | 'even' | 'odd'.

solve.description: If true, trigger a new solution after placing. Set false to batch multiple operations and solve once at the end.

slot.description: Slot ID returned by spawn_slot. Omit to use the Rhino you're already working in (the one you last used, or one you have open); a new Rhino is auto-spawned only if none is running.

tools.name: g1_start
tools.title: Start Grasshopper 1
tools.description: Starts Grasshopper

slot.description: Slot ID returned by spawn_slot. Omit to use the Rhino you're already working in (the one you last used, or one you have open); a new Rhino is auto-spawned only if none is running.

tools.name: g1_connect
tools.title: Connect GH1 Wire
tools.description: Wire an output parameter to an input parameter on the active GH1 canvas. 'src' and 'dst' may be a numeric index or a Name/NickName. For pure params (e.g. a slider) pass '' or '0'.

src.description: Output identifier: numeric index, output Name, or output NickName. Use '' or '0' for pure params.

dst.description: Input identifier: numeric index, input Name, or input NickName. Use '' or '0' for pure params.

replace.description: If true (the default), any sources already wired into the destination input are removed first, so this becomes its only wire. Pass false to add alongside them.

solve.description: If true, trigger a new solution after wiring. Set false to batch multiple operations and solve once at the end.

slot.description: Slot ID returned by spawn_slot. Omit to use the Rhino you're already working in (the one you last used, or one you have open); a new Rhino is auto-spawned only if none is running.

tools.name: open_doc
tools.title: Open / Import Document
tools.description: Import a .3dm (or other supported) file into the current document. Headless — no dialogs. Optionally clear the document first to make this behave like an open-in-place.

path.description: Absolute path to the file to import

clearFirst.description: If true, delete all objects in the current document before importing

slot.description: Slot ID returned by spawn_slot. Omit to use the Rhino you're already working in (the one you last used, or one you have open); a new Rhino is auto-spawned only if none is running.

tools.name: g1_solve_graph
tools.title: Solve GH1 Graph
tools.description: Solves the active GH canvas. zoom_views controls whether Rhino viewports zoom to the new preview: true=always, false=never, null=auto (zoom only when nothing was previewed before the solve).

zoom_views.description: Auto-zoom every Rhino viewport to the GH preview after solving. true=always, false=never, null=zoom only when nothing was visible pre-solve.

slot.description: Slot ID returned by spawn_slot. Omit to use the Rhino you're already working in (the one you last used, or one you have open); a new Rhino is auto-spawned only if none is running.

tools.name: g1_place_component
tools.title: Place GH1 Component
tools.description: Place a Grasshopper component onto the active GH1 canvas. 'selector' may be a Guid (proxy id) or a component name. Matches obsolete/hidden by name only when includeDeprecated is true (a Guid always works); ambiguous names return candidates.

selector.description: Component Guid (proxy id) or component Name (case-insensitive).

solve.description: If true, trigger a new solution after placing. Set false to batch multiple operations and solve once at the end.

includeDeprecated.description: Also match obsolete/hidden components by name (a Guid always works). Default false.

slot.description: Slot ID returned by spawn_slot. Omit to use the Rhino you're already working in (the one you last used, or one you have open); a new Rhino is auto-spawned only if none is running.

tools.name: get_viewport_image
tools.title: Capture Viewport Image
tools.description: Capture the active Rhino viewport as JPG. Returns the image plus a JSON metadata block describing the resulting camera, display mode, framed scene bounds, and on-screen object count — use the metadata to diagnose empty/off-screen captures without re-shooting.

view.description: Standard view: top, bottom, left, right, front, back, perspective

displayMode.description: Display mode by English name: Wireframe, Shaded, Rendered, Ghosted, X-Ray, Technical, Artistic, Pen, Monochrome, Arctic, Raytraced

boxMin.description: Frame this bounding box (min corner). Pair with boxMax. Replaces zoom — agent supplies what to frame, tool computes how far back to stand.

boxMax.description: Frame this bounding box (max corner). Pair with boxMin.

zoom.description: Magnification factor: >1 zoom in, 0<x<1 zoom out. Applied after boxMin/boxMax if both supplied.

slot.description: Slot ID returned by spawn_slot. Omit to use the Rhino you're already working in (the one you last used, or one you have open); a new Rhino is auto-spawned only if none is running.

tools.name: close_doc
tools.title: Close Document
tools.description: Close the current Rhino document. If path is given, save to that .3dm path first; otherwise discard unsaved changes.

path.description: Optional absolute .3dm path to save to before closing. Omit to close without saving.

slot.description: Slot ID returned by spawn_slot. Omit to use the Rhino you're already working in (the one you last used, or one you have open); a new Rhino is auto-spawned only if none is running.

tools.name: set_selection
tools.title: Set Selection
tools.description: Select objects by filter (IDs, names, layer, geometry type). Clears existing selection.

layer.description: Layer full path — selects all objects on layer

geometryType.description: Filter by type: point, pointset, curve, surface, brep, mesh, annotation, light, block

slot.description: Slot ID returned by spawn_slot. Omit to use the Rhino you're already working in (the one you last used, or one you have open); a new Rhino is auto-spawned only if none is running.

tools.name: run_command
tools.title: Run Rhino Command
tools.description: Execute any Rhino command string and return command window output. Example: "_Box 0,0,0 10,10,10 _Enter"

slot.description: Slot ID returned by spawn_slot. Omit to use the Rhino you're already working in (the one you last used, or one you have open); a new Rhino is auto-spawned only if none is running.

tools.name: close_slot
tools.title: Close Rhino Slot
tools.description: Close a Rhino slot gracefully. Saves nothing. On success `payload.closed` is true. On failure `error.code` is one of: `slot_not_found` (no slot with that ID is currently running), `cannot_close_adopted` (the slot was a user-started Rhino, the router will not kill it; ask the user to close the Rhino window), `close_failed` (the router tried to close the slot but the operation did not complete; the slot may still be running).

slot.description: Slot ID returned by spawn_slot, or an animal-name slot adopted from a user-started Rhino

tools.name: g1_clear_canvas
tools.title: Clear GH1 Canvas
tools.description: Remove every object from the active GH1 canvas. Destructive — requires confirm=true.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually wipe the canvas. Defaults to false as a safety guard.

solve.description: If true, trigger a new solution after clearing. Set false to batch multiple operations and solve once at the end.

slot.description: Slot ID returned by spawn_slot. Omit to use the Rhino you're already working in (the one you last used, or one you have open); a new Rhino is auto-spawned only if none is running.

tools.name: ask_user
tools.title: Ask User
tools.description: Ask the Rhino user to choose among options when you need a decision you cannot make yourself. Pass EVERY question you need answered in this one call: the Rhino AI panel shows them one page at a time (radio for single choice, checkboxes for multi) and returns them as a single reply. This tool does NOT wait for the answers: it poses the questions and returns immediately. Only on success, STOP and end your turn; on failure, fix the input and retry; the user's answers arrive as their next message, then continue.

questions.description: The questions to ask, in the order they should be shown

slot.description: Slot ID returned by spawn_slot. Omit to use the Rhino you're already working in (the one you last used, or one you have open); a new Rhino is auto-spawned only if none is running.

tools.name: get_selection
tools.title: Get Selection
tools.description: Return all currently selected objects in Rhino.

slot.description: Slot ID returned by spawn_slot. Omit to use the Rhino you're already working in (the one you last used, or one you have open); a new Rhino is auto-spawned only if none is running.

tools.name: get_commands
tools.title: List Rhino Commands
tools.description: Discover Rhino command names available to run_command. Returns English names from all registered plugins (including those not yet loaded). Use filter to narrow the list before calling run_command.

filter.description: Substring filter (case-insensitive). Strongly recommended — unfiltered results can exceed 1000 commands.

slot.description: Slot ID returned by spawn_slot. Omit to use the Rhino you're already working in (the one you last used, or one you have open); a new Rhino is auto-spawned only if none is running.

{"payload":{"model_units":"Centimeters","inputs":[{"name":"_vectors","description":"Sun vectors from the "LB SunPath" component, which will be used
to determine the number of hours of direct sunlight received by the
test _geometry.","optional":true},{"name":"_timestep_","description":"A positive integer for the number of timesteps per hour at
which the "LB SunPath" component generated sun vectors. This is used
to correctly interpret the time duration represented by each of
the input sun vectors. (Default: 1 for 1 vector per hour).","optional":true},{"name":"_geometry","description":"Rhino Breps and/or Rhino Meshes for which direct sun analysis
will be conducted. If Breps are input, they will be subdivided using
the _grid_size to yeild individual points at which analysis will
occur. If a Mesh is input, direct sun analysis analysis will be
performed for each face of this mesh instead of subdividing it.","optional":true},{"name":"context_","description":"Rhino Breps and/or Rhino Meshes representing context geometry
that can block sunlight to the test _geometry.","optional":true},{"name":"_grid_size","description":"A positive number in Rhino model units for the size of grid
cells at which the input _geometry will be subdivided for direct sun
analysis. The smaller the grid size, the higher the resolution of
the analysis and the longer the calculation will take.  So it is
recommended that one start with a large value here and decrease
the value as needed. However, the grid size should usually be
smaller than the dimensions of the smallest piece of the _geometry
and context_ in order to yield meaningful results.","optional":true},{"name":"_offset_dist_","description":"A number for the distance to move points from the surfaces
of the input _geometry.  Typically, this should be a small positive
number to ensure points are not blocked by the mesh but it can be
equal to zero when geo_block_ is False. (Default: 10 cm when
geo_block_ is True and zero when geo_block_ is False).","optional":true},{"name":"geo_block_","description":"Set to "True" to count the input _geometry as opaque and
set to "False" to discount the _geometry from the calculation and
only look at context_ that blocks the sun. (Default: True).","optional":true},{"name":"legend_par_","description":"Optional legend parameters from the "LB Legend Parameters"
that will be used to customize the display of the results.","optional":true},{"name":"_cpu_count_","description":"An integer to set the number of CPUs used in the execution of the
intersection calculation. If unspecified, it will automatically default
to one less than the number of CPUs currently available on the
machine or 1 if only one processor is available.","optional":true},{"name":"_run","description":"Set to "True" to run the component and perform direct sun analysis.","optional":true}],"outputs":[{"name":"out","count":0,"types":[],"sample":[],"description":"..."},{"name":"points","count":16,"types":["<class 'Rhino.Geometry.Point3d'>"],"sample":["50,50,10","50,150,10","50,250,10","50,350,10"],"description":"The grid of points on the test _geometry that are be used to perform
the direct sun analysis."},{"name":"results","count":16,"types":["<class 'float'>"],"sample":["1.0","1.0","1.0","1.0"],"description":"A list of numbers that aligns with the points. Each number indicates
the number of hours of direct sunlight received by each of the
points.  Note that is is the number of hours out of the total
number of connected _vectors."},{"name":"mesh","count":1,"types":["<class 'Rhino.Geometry.Mesh'>"],"sample":["Rhino.Geometry.Mesh"],"description":"A colored mesh of the test _geometry representing the hours of direct
sunlight received by this input _geometry"},{"name":"legend","count":3,"types":["<class 'IronPython.NewTypes.Grasshopper.Kernel.Types.GH_GeometricGoo`1#IGH_BakeAwareData#IGH_PreviewData_21$22'>","<class 'Rhino.Geometry.Mesh'>"],"sample":["Rhino.Geometry.Mesh","hours","1.00"],"description":"A legend showing the number of hours that correspond to the colors
of the mesh."},{"name":"title","count":1,"types":["<class 'IronPython.NewTypes.Grasshopper.Kernel.Types.GH_GeometricGoo`1#IGH_BakeAwareData#IGH_PreviewData_21$22'>"],"sample":["Direct Sun Hours"],"description":"A text object for the study title."},{"name":"int_mtx","count":1,"types":["<class 'IronPython.NewTypes.System.Object_2$2'>"],"sample":["Sun Intersection Matrix (16 items)"],"description":"A Matrix object that can be connected to the "LB Deconstruct Matrix"
component to obtain detailed vector-by-vector results of the study.
Each sub-list of the matrix (aka. branch of the Data Tree) represents
one of the points used for analysis. The length of each sub-list
matches the number of _vectors used for the analysis. Each value
in the sub-list is either a "1", indicating that the sun is visible
for that vector, or a "0", indicating that the sun is not visible
for that vector."}],"errors":[],"warnings":[]}}
